heroHeadline: Putin-Xi Beijing Summit Opens — Ukraine HUR Confirms Stepnohirsk; Ka-27 Helicopter Destroyed; 209 Russian Drones Overnight (180 Intercepted)
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,545, Russian President Putin arrived in Beijing for a two-day summit with Xi Jinping — seeking Chinese economic and diplomatic backing as Western sanctions deepen, one day after a Russian drone embarrassingly struck the Chinese cargo vessel KSL Deyang in the Black Sea. Overnight, Russia launched 209 Shahed drones; Ukraine intercepted 180 (86%), but a warehouse in Izmail district (Odesa Oblast) was hit and a man was injured in Kherson. On the battlefield, Ukraine's HUR released footage confirming the 'Artan' special unit secured Stepnohirsk in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, and the Ukrainian Navy destroyed a Russian Ka-27 helicopter over the Black Sea. Ukraine also announced its first domestically-developed glide bomb is combat-ready. Russia captured Petropavlivka and Stepova Novoselivka in the Kupiansk direction. Russian cumulative losses reached ~1,351,150 personnel (+1,140 in 24 hours). NBC News reported Ukraine's new 60-mile-range midrange drones are devastating Russian rear targets at an 'unprecedented rate.'
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, France 24, NPR, CNN, NBC News, PBS, The Moscow Times, CGTN, Newsweek, Yahoo News, Kyiv Post, Euromaidan Press, EMPR Media, CNBC, Semafor, and Euronews. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
